description: Defines interfaces and classes for a WorkerPool implementation, including job scheduling, revoking, and monitoring within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: IWorkerPool
classes.description: Interface for a worker pool managing job submission, scheduling, revoking, and snapshotting.

classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IWorkerPool managing thread pool, timer, and job scheduling.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the thread pool with optional priority.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job to run at a specific future time.

methods.name: Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules an existing job to a new time.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a scheduled or running job.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Waits for all jobs to complete and joins the thread pool.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID for a given index.

methods.name: Snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current worker pool status.

methods.name: WaitForStop
methods.description: Waits for the worker pool to stop within a timeout.
